parameters.query:
WITH input AS (SELECT $1::jsonb data), b AS (SELECT data,(data->>'organization_id')::uuid organization_id FROM input),
doc AS (
 INSERT INTO legal_documents(organization_id,document_type,title,language_code,source_type,source_external_id,source_url,file_name,mime_type,content_hash,status,is_official,metadata)
 SELECT organization_id,'construction_legal_document',data->>'file_name','vi','google_drive',data->>'file_id',data->>'source_url',data->>'file_name',data->>'mime_type',data->>'source_hash','processing',false,jsonb_build_object('corpus',data->>'corpus','drive_modified_time',data->>'modified_time') FROM b
 ON CONFLICT(organization_id,source_type,source_external_id) DO UPDATE SET source_url=excluded.source_url,file_name=excluded.file_name,mime_type=excluded.mime_type,content_hash=excluded.content_hash,metadata=legal_documents.metadata||excluded.metadata
 RETURNING *
), complete AS (
 SELECT v.id FROM legal_document_versions v,doc d WHERE v.document_id=d.id AND v.is_current=true AND v.parse_status='completed' AND v.chunk_status='completed' AND v.embedding_status='completed' AND v.index_status='completed' LIMIT 1
), active_other AS (
 SELECT r.id FROM legal_ingestion_runs r,doc d WHERE r.document_id=d.id AND r.operation_key<>d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash AND r.status='processing' AND r.updated_at>=now()-interval '12 hours' LIMIT 1
), claimed AS (
 INSERT INTO legal_ingestion_runs(organization_id,operation_key,source_external_id,source_content_hash,document_id,status,metadata)
 SELECT d.organization_id,d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash,d.source_external_id,d.content_hash,d.id,CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM complete) THEN 'skipped' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'failed' ELSE 'processing' END,jsonb_build_object('workflow_id','Bzi9dHprJPgP54H2') FROM doc d
 ON CONFLICT(operation_key) DO UPDATE SET attempt_count=legal_ingestion_runs.attempt_count+1,status=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM complete) THEN 'skipped' WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'failed' ELSE 'processing' END,error_code=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'DOCUMENT_BUSY' ELSE null END,error_message=CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM active_other) THEN 'another source version is processing' ELSE null END,started_at=now(),completed_at=null
 WHERE legal_ingestion_runs.status='failed' OR (legal_ingestion_runs.status='processing' AND legal_ingestion_runs.updated_at<now()-interval '12 hours')
 RETURNING *
), run_row AS (
 SELECT c.*,true AS claimed_by_this_execution FROM claimed c UNION ALL SELECT r.*,false AS claimed_by_this_execution FROM legal_ingestion_runs r,doc d WHERE r.operation_key=d.organization_id::text||':'||d.source_external_id||':'||d.content_hash AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM claimed) LIMIT 1
)
SELECT b.data->>'organization_id' organization_id,b.data->>'corpus' corpus,b.data->>'file_id' file_id,b.data->>'file_name' file_name,b.data->>'mime_type' mime_type,(b.data->>'size_bytes')::bigint size_bytes,b.data->>'source_url' source_url,b.data->>'source_hash' source_hash,b.data->>'language_code' language_code,b.data->>'modified_time' modified_time,d.id::text document_id,r.id::text run_id,c.id::text completed_version_id,
 CASE WHEN c.id IS NOT NULL THEN 'skipped' WHEN r.claimed_by_this_execution AND r.status='processing' THEN 'process' ELSE 'busy' END action
FROM b CROSS JOIN doc d CROSS JOIN run_row r LEFT JOIN complete c ON true;

nodes.name: Prepare Legal Office OCR Batches
nodes.notes: Splits DOCX by logical OOXML body blocks and PPTX by slides before Gemini OCR; prunes unreachable package assets and caps oversized batches.

nodes.name: Loop Over Legal OCR Batches
nodes.notes: Runs one page batch at a time so Gemini retries are independent per batch.

nodes.name: Encode Legal OCR Batch
nodes.notes: Converts only the current loop batch to base64, avoiding whole-file base64 duplication in execution data.

nodes.name: Gemini Legal Document OCR
nodes.notes: One Gemini request per page batch; each batch retries independently up to four attempts.

nodes.name: Normalize Legal Extracted Text
nodes.notes: Preserves page markers and rejects empty/truncated extraction.

nodes.name: Prepare Legal Metadata Request
nodes.notes: 18k-character bounded metadata sample; full source remains authoritative.

nodes.name: Extract Legal Metadata Qwen
nodes.notes: Metadata only; deterministic downstream validator rejects unsupported values.

nodes.name: Validate Legal Metadata
nodes.notes: Every extracted string/date must be supported by filename or source; effective is never inferred.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),

/* =========================================================
   1. Parse input
   ========================================================= */
b AS (
    SELECT
        data,
        NULLIF(data->>'document_id', '')::uuid AS document_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'run_id', '')::uuid AS run_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'organization_id', '')::uuid AS organization_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'source_hash', '') AS source_hash
    FROM input
),

/* =========================================================
   2. Validate các trường bắt buộc
   ========================================================= */
validated_input AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM b
    WHERE document_id IS NOT NULL
      AND run_id IS NOT NULL
      AND organization_id IS NOT NULL
      AND source_hash IS NOT NULL
),

/* =========================================================
   3. LOCK theo document_id
      Ngăn 2 workflow cùng tạo version_number giống nhau
   ========================================================= */
document_lock AS (
    SELECT
        v.*,
        pg_advisory_xact_lock(
            hashtextextended(v.document_id::text, 0)
        ) AS _document_locked
    FROM validated_input v
),

/* =========================================================
   4. Cập nhật document metadata
   ========================================================= */
doc_update AS (
    UPDATE legal_documents d
    SET
        metadata =
            COALESCE(d.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'pending_source_hash',
                l.source_hash
            ),
        updated_at = now()
    FROM document_lock l
    WHERE d.id = l.document_id
      AND d.organization_id = l.organization_id
    RETURNING d.id
),

/* =========================================================
   5. Tìm version đã tồn tại theo document + source_hash
   ========================================================= */
existing_version AS (
    SELECT
        v.*
    FROM legal_document_versions v
    JOIN document_lock l
      ON l.document_id = v.document_id
     AND l.organization_id = v.organization_id
     AND l.source_hash = v.source_content_hash
),

/* =========================================================
   6. Tính version_number mới
      Đã được bảo vệ bởi advisory lock
   ========================================================= */
next_version AS (
    SELECT
        l.document_id,
        l.organization_id,
        l.source_hash,
        COALESCE(
            MAX(v.version_number),
            0
        ) + 1 AS version_number
    FROM document_lock l
    LEFT JOIN legal_document_versions v
      ON v.document_id = l.document_id
     AND v.organization_id = l.organization_id
    GROUP BY
        l.document_id,
        l.organization_id,
        l.source_hash
),

/* =========================================================
   7. INSERT version mới
      Nếu hash đã tồn tại thì UPDATE version cũ
   ========================================================= */
version_upsert AS (
    INSERT INTO legal_document_versions (
        document_id,
        organization_id,
        version_number,
        source_content_hash,
        extracted_text,
        normalized_text,
        parse_status,
        chunk_status,
        embedding_status,
        index_status,
        is_current,
        extraction_method,
        extracted_fields
    )
    SELECT
        l.document_id,
        l.organization_id,
        n.version_number,
        l.source_hash,

        l.data->>'raw_text',

        l.data->>'normalized_text',

        'completed',

        'processing',

        'processing',

        'pending',

        false,

        'gemini_ocr_batched',

        jsonb_build_object(

            'extraction',
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.data->'extraction') = 'object'
                THEN l.data->'extraction'
                ELSE '{}'::jsonb
            END,

            'legal_metadata',
            CASE
                WHEN jsonb_typeof(l.data->'legal_metadata') = 'object'
                THEN l.data->'legal_metadata'
                ELSE '{}'::jsonb
            END,

            'metadata_sample_chars',
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    l.data->>'metadata_sample_chars',
                    ''
                )::integer,
                0
            )
        )

    FROM document_lock l
    JOIN next_version n
      ON n.document_id = l.document_id
     AND n.organization_id = l.organization_id
     AND n.source_hash = l.source_hash

    /*
       Chỉ INSERT nếu source_hash này chưa tồn tại.
    */
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM existing_version e
        WHERE e.document_id = l.document_id
          AND e.organization_id = l.organization_id
          AND e.source_content_hash = l.source_hash
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        document_id,
        source_content_hash
    )
    DO UPDATE SET

        extracted_text =
            EXCLUDED.extracted_text,

        normalized_text =
            EXCLUDED.normalized_text,

        parse_status =
            'completed',

        chunk_status =
            'processing',

        embedding_status =
            'processing',

        index_status =
            'pending',

        is_current =
            false,

        extraction_method =
            EXCLUDED.extraction_method,

        extracted_fields =
            EXCLUDED.extracted_fields,

        updated_at =
            now()

    WHERE NOT (
        legal_document_versions.is_current = true
        AND legal_document_versions.parse_status = 'completed'
        AND legal_document_versions.chunk_status = 'completed'
        AND legal_document_versions.embedding_status = 'completed'
        AND legal_document_versions.index_status = 'completed'
    )

    RETURNING *
),

/* =========================================================
   8. Chọn version cuối cùng để pipeline sử dụng
   ========================================================= */
selected AS (

    /* Version vừa INSERT/UPDATE */
    SELECT *
    FROM version_upsert

    UNION ALL

    /* Nếu version đã hoàn chỉnh và không UPDATE,
       sử dụng version hiện có */
    SELECT e.*
    FROM existing_version e
    WHERE NOT EXISTS (
        SELECT 1
        FROM version_upsert
    )
),

/* =========================================================
   9. Xóa embeddings cũ của version đang được xử lý
   ========================================================= */
deleted_embeddings AS (
    DELETE FROM legal_chunk_embeddings e
    USING legal_document_chunks c
    JOIN selected s
      ON s.id = c.document_version_id
    WHERE e.chunk_id = c.id
      AND s.is_current = false
    RETURNING
        e.id,
        e.chunk_id
),

/* =========================================================
   10. Xóa chunks cũ
       Dependency vào deleted_embeddings giữ đúng pipeline
   ========================================================= */
deleted_chunks AS (
    DELETE FROM legal_document_chunks c
    USING selected s
    WHERE c.document_version_id = s.id
      AND s.is_current = false
      AND (
          SELECT COUNT(*)
          FROM deleted_embeddings
      ) >= 0
    RETURNING c.id
),

/* =========================================================
   11. Update ingestion run
   ========================================================= */
run_update AS (
    UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r
    SET
        document_version_id =
            s.id,

        status =
            'processing',

        error_code =
            NULL,

        error_message =
            NULL,

        completed_at =
            NULL,

        metadata =
            COALESCE(
                r.metadata,
                '{}'::jsonb
            )
            || jsonb_build_object(
                'metadata_validated',
                true,

                'document_version_id',
                s.id::text,

                'source_hash',
                l.source_hash
            ),

        updated_at =
            now()

    FROM selected s
    JOIN document_lock l
      ON true

    WHERE r.id = l.run_id
      AND r.organization_id = l.organization_id

    RETURNING r.id
)

/* =========================================================
   12. OUTPUT cho node n8n tiếp theo
   ========================================================= */
SELECT
    l.organization_id::text
        AS organization_id,

    l.data->>'corpus'
        AS corpus,

    l.data->>'file_id'
        AS file_id,

    l.data->>'file_name'
        AS file_name,

    l.data->>'mime_type'
        AS mime_type,

    l.data->>'source_url'
        AS source_url,

    l.source_hash
        AS source_hash,

    l.data->>'language_code'
        AS language_code,

    l.document_id::text
        AS document_id,

    l.run_id::text
        AS run_id,

    s.id::text
        AS document_version_id,

    l.data->'legal_metadata'
        AS legal_metadata

FROM document_lock l
CROSS JOIN selected s;

nodes.notes: Creates or safely resets only an incomplete source-hash version; completed versions are immutable.

nodes.name: Chunk Legal Document
nodes.notes: 3500-character/500-chunk bounds with original page and article lineage.

parameters.query:
WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),

prepared AS (
    SELECT
        data,

        NULLIF(data->>'document_version_id', '')::uuid
            AS document_version_id,

        NULLIF(data->>'organization_id', '')::uuid
            AS organization_id,

        NULLIF(data->>'chunk_index', '')::integer
            AS chunk_index,

        NULLIF(data->>'section', '')
            AS section,

        NULLIF(data->>'article_ref', '')
            AS article_ref,

        NULLIF(data->>'page_start', '')::integer
            AS page_start,

        NULLIF(data->>'page_end', '')::integer
            AS page_end,

        NULLIF(data->>'title', '')
            AS title,

        NULLIF(data->>'content', '')
            AS content,

        NULLIF(data->>'normalized_content', '')
            AS normalized_content,

        COALESCE(
            NULLIF(data->>'language_code', ''),
            'vi'
        )
            AS language_code,

        NULLIF(data->>'token_count', '')::integer
            AS token_count,

        NULLIF(data->>'content_hash', '')
            AS content_hash,

        CASE
            WHEN jsonb_typeof(data->'metadata') = 'object'
            THEN data->'metadata'
            ELSE '{}'::jsonb
        END
            AS metadata

    FROM input
)

INSERT INTO legal_document_chunks (
    document_version_id,
    organization_id,
    chunk_index,
    section,
    article_ref,
    page_start,
    page_end,
    title,
    content,
    normalized_content,
    language_code,
    token_count,
    content_hash,
    metadata
)

SELECT
    document_version_id,
    organization_id,
    chunk_index,
    section,
    article_ref,
    page_start,
    page_end,
    title,
    content,
    normalized_content,
    language_code,
    token_count,
    content_hash,
    metadata

FROM prepared

ON CONFLICT (
    document_version_id,
    chunk_index
)

DO UPDATE SET
    section = EXCLUDED.section,
    article_ref = EXCLUDED.article_ref,
    page_start = EXCLUDED.page_start,
    page_end = EXCLUDED.page_end,
    title = EXCLUDED.title,
    content = EXCLUDED.content,
    normalized_content = EXCLUDED.normalized_content,
    language_code = EXCLUDED.language_code,
    token_count = EXCLUDED.token_count,
    content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash,
    metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata

RETURNING
    id::text AS chunk_id,
    document_version_id::text AS document_version_id,
    organization_id::text AS organization_id,
    chunk_index,
    section,
    article_ref,
    page_start,
    page_end,
    title,
    content,
    normalized_content,
    language_code,
    token_count,
    content_hash,
    metadata;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),

model AS (
    INSERT INTO embedding_models (
        model_name,
        model_version,
        dimension,
        provider,
        distance_metric,
        normalization,
        is_active,
        metadata
    )
    VALUES (
        'qwen3-embedding-8b',
        'cic-ai-api',
        1024,
        'cic-ai-api',
        'cosine',
        'l2',
        true,
        jsonb_build_object(
            'source_dimension', 4096,
            'storage_dimension', 1024, 'projection', 'signed-fold-v1'
        )
    )

    ON CONFLICT (
        provider,
        model_name,
        model_version,
        dimension
    )

    DO UPDATE SET
        metadata =
            embedding_models.metadata
            || EXCLUDED.metadata,

        is_active = true

    RETURNING id
)

SELECT
    data->>'chunk_id'
        AS chunk_id,

    data->>'document_version_id'
        AS document_version_id,

    data->>'organization_id'
        AS organization_id,

    (data->>'chunk_index')::integer
        AS chunk_index,

    data->>'content_hash'
        AS content_hash,

    data->'embedding'
        AS embedding,

    (
        SELECT id::text
        FROM model
        LIMIT 1
    )
        AS embedding_model_id

FROM input;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
)

INSERT INTO legal_chunk_embeddings (
    chunk_id,
    organization_id,
    embedding_model_id,
    embedding,
    content_hash,
    is_active,
    is_retrievable,
    metadata
)

SELECT
    (data->>'chunk_id')::uuid,

    (data->>'organization_id')::uuid,

    (data->>'embedding_model_id')::uuid,

    (data->'embedding')::text::vector,

    data->>'content_hash',

    true,

    false,

    jsonb_build_object(
        'organization_id',
        data->>'organization_id',

        'document_version_id',
        data->>'document_version_id',

        'chunk_index',
        (data->>'chunk_index')::integer,

        'model',
        'qwen3-embedding-8b',

        'dimension',
        1024,

        'normalization',
        'l2'
    )

FROM input

ON CONFLICT (
    chunk_id,
    embedding_model_id,
    content_hash
)

DO UPDATE SET
    embedding =
        EXCLUDED.embedding,

    is_active =
        true,

    is_retrievable =
        false,

    metadata =
        EXCLUDED.metadata

RETURNING
    id::text AS embedding_id,

    chunk_id::text AS chunk_id,

    organization_id::text AS organization_id,

    embedding_model_id::text AS embedding_model_id,

    content_hash;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),

b AS (
    SELECT
        (data->>'document_version_id')::uuid AS version_id,
        (data->>'document_id')::uuid AS document_id,
        (data->>'run_id')::uuid AS run_id
    FROM input
),

counts AS (
    SELECT
        COUNT(DISTINCT c.id)::int AS total_chunks,

        COUNT(DISTINCT e.chunk_id)::int AS total_embeddings

    FROM b

    JOIN legal_document_chunks c
        ON c.document_version_id = b.version_id

    LEFT JOIN legal_chunk_embeddings e
        ON e.chunk_id = c.id
       AND e.content_hash = c.content_hash
       AND e.is_active = true
),

valid AS (
    SELECT *
    FROM counts
    WHERE total_chunks > 0
      AND total_chunks = total_embeddings
),

/* =========================================================
   Tắt version CURRENT cũ
   ========================================================= */

old_off AS (
    UPDATE legal_document_versions v

    SET is_current = false

    FROM b, valid

    WHERE v.document_id = b.document_id
      AND v.id <> b.version_id
      AND v.is_current = true

    RETURNING v.id
),

/* =========================================================
   Tắt khả năng retrieve của embedding thuộc version cũ
   ========================================================= */

old_embeddings_off AS (
    UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e

    SET is_retrievable = false

    FROM legal_document_chunks c,
         old_off o

    WHERE c.document_version_id = o.id
      AND e.chunk_id = c.id

    RETURNING e.id
),

/* =========================================================
   Bật version mới thành CURRENT + COMPLETED
   ========================================================= */

version_on AS (
    UPDATE legal_document_versions v

    SET
        parse_status = 'completed',
        chunk_status = 'completed',
        embedding_status = 'completed',
        index_status = 'completed',
        is_current = true,
        updated_at = now()

    FROM b, valid

    WHERE v.id = b.version_id

    RETURNING
        v.id,
        v.extracted_fields
),

/* =========================================================
   Cho phép retrieve embedding của version mới
   ========================================================= */

new_embeddings_on AS (
    UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e

    SET
        is_retrievable = true

    FROM legal_document_chunks c,
         version_on v

    WHERE c.document_version_id = v.id
      AND e.chunk_id = c.id
      AND e.is_active = true

    RETURNING e.id
),

/* =========================================================
   Activate document
   ========================================================= */

doc_on AS (
    UPDATE legal_documents d

    SET
        status = 'active',

        is_official = true,

        document_type =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    v.extracted_fields
                        #>> '{legal_metadata,document_type}',
                    ''
                ),
                'other'
            ),

        title =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    v.extracted_fields
                        #>> '{legal_metadata,title}',
                    ''
                ),
                d.file_name
            ),

        document_number =
            NULLIF(
                v.extracted_fields
                    #>> '{legal_metadata,document_number}',
                ''
            ),

        issuing_authority =
            NULLIF(
                v.extracted_fields
                    #>> '{legal_metadata,issuing_authority}',
                ''
            ),

        jurisdiction = 'VN',

        issued_date =
            NULLIF(
                v.extracted_fields
                    #>> '{legal_metadata,issued_date}',
                ''
            )::date,

        effective_date =
            NULLIF(
                v.extracted_fields
                    #>> '{legal_metadata,effective_date}',
                ''
            )::date,

        expiry_date =
            NULLIF(
                v.extracted_fields
                    #>> '{legal_metadata,expiry_date}',
                ''
            )::date,

        legal_status =
            COALESCE(
                NULLIF(
                    v.extracted_fields
                        #>> '{legal_metadata,legal_status}',
                    ''
                ),
                'unknown'
            ),

        metadata =
            (
                COALESCE(d.metadata, '{}'::jsonb)
                - 'pending_source_hash'
            )
            ||
            jsonb_build_object(
                'corpus',
                'VN_CONSTRUCTION_LAW',

                'topics',
                COALESCE(
                    v.extracted_fields
                        #> '{legal_metadata,topics}',
                    '[]'::jsonb
                ),

                'metadata_validated',
                true
            ),

        updated_at = now()

    FROM b,
         version_on v,
         new_embeddings_on ne

    WHERE d.id = b.document_id

    RETURNING d.id
),

/* =========================================================
   Complete ingestion run
   ========================================================= */

run_done AS (
    UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r

    SET
        status = 'completed',

        completed_at = now(),

        error_code = NULL,

        error_message = NULL,

        document_version_id = b.version_id,

        updated_at = now()

    FROM b,
         doc_on d

    WHERE r.id = b.run_id

    RETURNING r.id
)

/* =========================================================
   FINAL RESULT
   ========================================================= */

SELECT
    b.document_id::text
        AS document_id,

    b.version_id::text
        AS document_version_id,

    b.run_id::text
        AS run_id,

    c.total_chunks,

    c.total_embeddings,

    (
        c.total_chunks > 0
        AND c.total_chunks = c.total_embeddings
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM version_on
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM new_embeddings_on
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM doc_on
        )
        AND EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM run_done
        )
    ) AS rag_complete

FROM b
CROSS JOIN counts c;

WITH input AS (
    SELECT $1::jsonb AS data
),

b AS (
    SELECT
        data,
        NULLIF(data->>'run_id', '')::uuid AS run_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'document_version_id', '')::uuid AS version_id,
        NULLIF(data->>'document_id', '')::uuid AS document_id
    FROM input
),

emb_off AS (
    UPDATE legal_chunk_embeddings e
    SET is_retrievable = false
    FROM legal_document_chunks c, b
    WHERE b.version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND c.document_version_id = b.version_id
      AND e.chunk_id = c.id
    RETURNING e.id
),

ver_fail AS (
    UPDATE legal_document_versions v
    SET
        chunk_status = 'failed',
        embedding_status = 'failed',
        index_status = 'failed',
        is_current = false,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM b
    WHERE b.version_id IS NOT NULL
      AND v.id = b.version_id
    RETURNING v.id
),

run_fail AS (
    UPDATE legal_ingestion_runs r
    SET
        status = 'failed',
        completed_at = now(),
        error_code = LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                b.data->>'error_code',
                'INGESTION_FAILED'
            ),
            100
        ),
        error_message = LEFT(
            COALESCE(
                b.data->>'error_message',
                'legal ingestion failed'
            ),
            500
        ),
        document_version_id = b.version_id,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM b
    WHERE b.run_id IS NOT NULL
      AND r.id = b.run_id
    RETURNING r.id
),

doc_fail AS (
    UPDATE legal_documents d
    SET
        status = CASE
            WHEN EXISTS (
                SELECT 1
                FROM legal_document_versions v
                WHERE v.document_id = d.id
                  AND v.is_current = true
            )
            THEN d.status
            ELSE 'failed'
        END,
        updated_at = now()
    FROM b
    WHERE b.document_id IS NOT NULL
      AND d.id = b.document_id
    RETURNING d.id
)

SELECT
    'failed' AS status,
    b.data->>'file_id' AS file_id,
    b.data->>'file_name' AS file_name,
    COALESCE(
        b.data->>'error_code',
        'INGESTION_FAILED'
    ) AS error_code,
    LEFT(
        COALESCE(
            b.data->>'error_message',
            'legal ingestion failed'
        ),
        500
    ) AS error_message
FROM b;
